title: Beautiful colors but very messy.
text:
Beautiful colors but very messy.. This Opal Chunky Glitter has beautiful colors. The little sequins mixed with the glitter made my earrings look great. I added a couple of the different colors of glitter to some resin to make beautiful earrings.

The glitter was not easy to use because too much would come out of the little bottle no matter how hard I tried to prevent it from happening. I had glitter on my molds and the liner I was using to keep it from getting on everything else. It didn't clean up well, as a matter of fact, it left residue in my mold and my liner. It would not come off.

I will be recommending this Opal Chunky Glitter to family and friends because of the beautiful colors. I will warn them of the mess it makes and share my experience with them.
